title: Industrial engineering executive
description:
**Company Description**
SCM GARMENTS is a growing organization focused on applying industrial engineering principles to improve operational performance and resource utilization. The company is committed to optimizing processes, reducing waste, and supporting continuous improvement across its facilities. BLAPL values data-driven decision-making, collaboration, and practical innovation in day-to-day operations. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership of projects, and support a culture of safety and quality. The organization provides opportunities for professional development and exposure to diverse industrial engineering challenges.

**Role Description**
The Industrial Engineering Executive at scm garments, tirupur in a full-time capacity, focusing on process optimization and operational efficiency. Responsibilities include analyzing workflows, time and motion studies, and production data to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements. The role involves designing and implementing layout changes, work standards, and productivity enhancement initiatives in collaboration with operations, maintenance, and quality teams. The executive will support capacity planning, resource allocation, and cost-reduction projects, while ensuring adherence to safety, quality, and compliance requirements. The position also requires preparing reports, presenting findings to management, and tracking the impact of improvement initiatives over time.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in industrial engineering principles, including process design, workflow analysis, and productivity improvement.
* Ability to conduct data collection, statistical analysis, and performance measurement using relevant tools and software.
* Experience with production planning, capacity planning, and resource optimization in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Knowledge of lean methodologies, continuous improvement practices, and basic quality management concepts.
* Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with engineering or layout design tools (e.g., AutoCAD or similar) is an advantage.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking, and detail orientation, with the ability to translate findings into practical actions.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work on-site with cross-functional teams
* Diploma/Bachelor’s degree in IE/Textiles/Fashion designing or a related field; relevant work experience in industrial or manufacturing settings is preferred.

title: CUSTOMERCARE EXECUTIVE
description:
**Job title:**
Customer Care Executive

**Company:**
Orchid Natures (natural and herbal personal care)

**Location:**
[Tirupur, mangalam], full-time, 6 days a week

**Reports to:**
Operations head or co founder

**Role summary**

You are the voice of Orchid Natures for customers. You confirm orders, solve problems, reduce returns, and bring customers back to reorder.

**Key responsibilities**

1. **Confirm COD orders**
   on WhatsApp or by call before shipping, and mark each one confirmed, unreachable or cancelled.
2. **Handle failed deliveries (NDR).**
   Contact customers within 24 hours, reschedule delivery, and update the courier (Delhivery) portal.
3. **Answer customer queries**
   on WhatsApp, calls, email and Instagram about orders, delivery, product use and offers. Reply within 1 hour in working hours.
4. **Resolve complaints and returns:**
   wrong, damaged or missing items and refunds. Log each case and escalate anything above your limit.
5. **Track orders**
   in Shopify and the courier portal, and update customers proactively on delays.
6. **Send reorder reminders and follow-ups**
   to past customers, and ask happy customers for reviews and photos.
7. **Guide customers on products,**
   such as which shampoo or oil to choose and how to use it. Never make medical claims or promise results.
8. **Record and report:**
   keep a daily log of calls, confirmations, complaints and returns. Send a daily summary and a weekly COD return report.
9. **Share customer feedback**
   about products, packaging and delivery with the team.

**Skills and qualifications**

* Fluent in
  **Tamil and English**
  . Hindi or Malayalam is a plus.
* Clear, polite communication in writing and on calls.
* Comfortable with WhatsApp Business, Excel or Google Sheets, and Shopify basics (training provided).
* Patient, organized, and able to handle several chats at once.
* Graduate or diploma. 0–2 years of customer support or e-commerce experience.

**Weekly targets (KPIs)**

MeasureTargetCOD orders confirmed before shipping95%+COD return rateTrending from 35% toward 25%First response timeUnder 1 hourFailed deliveries contacted within 24 hours100%Complaints resolved within 48 hours90%+Reorder reminders sentDaily list completed

**Authority**

* Offer replacements or refunds up to a limit set by management.
* Escalate bigger cases to your manager the same day.

**Growth path:**
Senior Customer Care Executive, then Customer Experience Lead.

**What we offer:**
[15000 to 20000], incentive on COD return reduction and reorder conversions, training, and carrier growth also promotions

title: Head of Industrialization
description:
**Designation: Head of Industrialization**

**Department: Industrialization**

**Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu**

**Job Purpose**

The Head – Industrialization will lead the Industrialization function and drive

standardization, cost optimization, productivity improvement, and technical

excellence across garment manufacturing operations. The role will establish robust

manufacturing standards from product development through bulk production,

ensuring accurate SMV, costing, consumption, CPM, technical feasibility, and SOP

implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SMV – Method & Time Study**

* Lead method study, time study, operation breakdown, and SMV setting

for new and existing styles.

* Establish accurate and achievable SMVs based on standardized methods,

machines, and operator performance.

* Identify productivity improvement opportunities through method engineering,

line balancing and process optimization.

* Periodically review SMVs against actual production performance and update

standards where required.

**2. Product Costing**

* Drive accurate product costing covering fabric, trims, sewing, processing,

overheads, efficiency, rejection, and other manufacturing parameters.

* Validate costing assumptions with actual manufacturing data and ensure cost

competitiveness.

* Support Merchandising, Sourcing, and Manufacturing teams during product

development and order finalization.

* Identify cost-reduction opportunities without compromising quality or product

specifications.

**3. CPM – Cost Per Minute**

* Establish and maintain standardized CPM benchmarks across products,

operations, and manufacturing units.

* Analyze actual versus standard CPM and identify key cost and efficiency

gaps.

* Work closely with IE and Production teams to improve operational efficiency

and manufacturing cost performance.

**4. Consumption**

* Drive accurate fabric and garment consumption standards during product

development and pre-production.

* Validate consumption through marker efficiency, fabric width, shrinkage,

construction, and wastage parameters.

* Monitor actual versus standard consumption and initiate corrective actions for

deviations.

**5. Technical Support**

* Provide technical support for new product development, proto/sample,

pre-production, and bulk production.

* Evaluate manufacturing feasibility, construction, operation sequence, machine

requirements, and process risks.

* Resolve technical issues in coordination with Design, Merchandising, Quality,

Production, and Sourcing teams.

**6. SOP & amp; Documentation**

* Develop and maintain standardized SOPs, work instructions, technical standards, and process documentation.
* Ensure effective implementation of industrialization standards across factories.
* Establish systems for periodic review, audit, and continuous improvement of technical standards.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong expertise in Industrial Engineering, garment manufacturing, SMV, costing, CPM, and consumption.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills.
* Strong understanding of garment construction, manufacturing processes, and production systems.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive standardization across multiple manufacturing units.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Experience & amp; Qualification**

* 10–15+ years of relevant experience in garment manufacturing / Industrial Engineering / Industrialization.
* Degree/Diploma in Textile Technology, Apparel Technology, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
* Strong proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and industrial engineering tools.

title: Head - Central Planning
description:
**Job Title: Head of Central Planning**

**Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu**

**Experience: 10–15 years of experience in garment manufacturing**

**JOB PURPOSE**

Lead the centralised manufacturing planning function across all manufacturing units,

ensuring optimum capacity utilisation, effective order allocation, balanced factory

loading, material readiness, production execution and on-time delivery.

**CENTRAL PLANNING & STRATEGY**

* Develop and manage the overall central planning strategy across

manufacturing units.

* Establish standard planning processes, systems, formats and review

mechanisms.

* Consolidate business requirements and convert them into realistic

manufacturing plans.

* Develop monthly, quarterly and annual manufacturing plans aligned with

business projections.

* Drive proactive rather than reactive planning across the organisation.

**CAPACITY PLANNING & FACTORY LOADING**

* Develop factory-wise and line-wise capacity plans based on SMV, efficiency,

working days, product complexity and available resources.

* Allocate orders to factories based on capability, capacity and delivery

requirements.

* Ensure optimum and balanced utilisation of manufacturing capacity.
* Identify capacity gaps, excess capacity and future capacity requirements.
* Recommend capacity redistribution, additional shifts, outsourcing or capacity

expansion where required.

**ORDER & PRODUCTION PLANNING**

* Manage end-to-end order planning from order confirmation to production

completion.

* Prepare production plans aligned with committed delivery dates.
* Monitor planned vs. actual production, WIP, efficiency and order

completion.

* Prioritise critical orders and develop recovery plans for delayed orders.
* Ensure production plans are realistic, achievable and continuously updated.

**RAW MATERIAL & MATERIAL READINESS**

* Coordinate with Sourcing - Fabric, Sewing Trims and Packing Trims teams

to ensure material readiness.

* Monitor material availability against planned production requirements.
* Identify material shortages or delays that may impact production.
* Ensure production plans are aligned with actual material availability.
* Establish early-warning mechanisms for critical material risks.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION**

* Work closely with:
* Merchandising
* Sourcing - RM
* Production
* Industrial Engineering
* Quality
* Factory Heads
* Commercial & Logistics

Ensure business commitments, material availability, factory capacity and production

plans remain aligned.

**INDUSTRIAL ENGINEERING & EFFICIENCY**

* Work with IE teams to validate SMV, efficiency and capacity assumptions.
* Monitor planned vs. actual efficiency.
* Identify productivity gaps affecting capacity.
* Support line balancing, bottleneck reduction and capacity improvement.
* Incorporate product complexity and learning curves into planning.

**DELIVERY & RISK MANAGEMENT**

* Establish an early-warning system for delivery risks.
* Identify bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production delays in advance.
* Drive corrective and recovery actions with relevant teams.
* Monitor critical orders through regular review mechanisms.
* Develop contingency plans for capacity, material and production disruptions.

**MIS, SYSTEMS & ANALYTICS**

* Develop central planning dashboards and management MIS.
* Ensure accurate visibility of orders, capacity, production, WIP, material

readiness and delivery status.

* Drive ERP-based planning and data accuracy.
* Utilise Advanced Excel / Power BI for planning analysis and decision-making.
* Establish meaningful planning KPIs and performance dashboards.

**TEAM LEADERSHIP**

* Lead and develop the Central Planning / PPC team.
* Define clear KRAs, KPIs and accountability.
* Build planning capability through training and process improvement.
* Promote data-driven decision-making and strong planning discipline.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Capacity Utilisation
* Factory Loading Accuracy
* Production Plan Adherence
* On-Time Production
* On-Time Shipment
* Planning Accuracy
* Material Readiness
* WIP Control
* Production Efficiency
* Order Ageing
* Bottleneck Resolution
* Reduction in Last-Minute / Emergency Planning

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor degree in Textile, Apparel, Production, Industrial Engineering

or related discipline.

* 10–15 years of experience in garment manufacturing with strong exposure

to Central Planning / PPC.

* Experience in multi-factory planning and capacity management is

preferred.

* Strong knowledge of garment manufacturing, SMV, efficiency, capacity

planning and production systems.

* Strong analytical, leadership, communication and stakeholder-management

skills.

* Proficiency in ERP, Advanced Excel and Power BI/MIS preferred.
* Experience in sportswear / activewear manufacturing will be an added

advantage.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate should be a strong strategic and execution-oriented manufacturing planner who can connect business demand with manufacturing capacity and ensure the right order is planned at the right factory, with the right material and capacity, at the right time. The role requires strong ownership, analytical thinking, decision-making, cross- functional coordination and execution discipline to build a scalable and proactive central planning function.

title: Professional Driver
description:
**Company Description**
VRS Travels Tirupur is a taxi and transport service provider dedicated to serving customers across Tiruppur and nearby areas. The company focuses on delivering reliable, safe, and timely transportation for individuals, families, and businesses. VRS Travels Tirupur is committed to continuously improving customer service and making it easier for passengers to find, reach, and book rides. The team values professionalism, courteous behavior, and a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time Professional Driver role based in Tiruppur with a hybrid work arrangement, where some administrative or scheduling tasks may be completed from home. The Professional Driver will be responsible for safely operating company vehicles, picking up and dropping off passengers, and ensuring all trips are completed on time. Daily activities include following assigned routes, adhering to traffic and safety regulations, maintaining vehicle cleanliness, and conducting basic vehicle checks before and after trips. The driver will interact with customers, assist with luggage when needed, handle cash or digital payments, and report any incidents or maintenance needs to the supervisor. The role also involves coordinating with dispatch for trip assignments and providing clear, courteous communication to passengers throughout their journey.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong truck driving skills and experience operating commercial vehicles such as trucks or larger taxis.
* Candidates should possess a valid CDL Class A or equivalent heavy vehicle license, with a clean driving record and familiarity with local routes.
* Candidates should possess clear and professional communication skills to coordinate with dispatch and interact with passengers effectively.
* Candidates should possess excellent customer service skills, including courtesy, patience, and a focus on passenger comfort and safety.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of basic vehicle maintenance checks and safe handling of the truck or taxi in varied traffic and weather conditions.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as required by business needs.
* Strong sense of responsibility, punctuality, and adherence to safety and company policies.
* Previous experience as a professional driver, taxi driver, or commercial driver in Tiruppur or surrounding areas is an advantage.

title: Radiographer
description:
**Company Description**
REVATHI MEDICAL CENTER (Inst. Code - 500), TIRUPUR is a higher education institution located at 10, Kumar Nagar West, Avinashi Road, Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India. The center is focused on developing healthcare professionals through structured academic and clinical training. Its programs emphasize practical skills, ethical medical practice, and community-oriented healthcare. Learners and staff work in an environment that encourages continuous learning, collaboration, and patient-centered care.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Radiographer role based in Thrissur. The Radiographer will perform diagnostic imaging procedures such as X-rays and other radiologic examinations, following prescribed protocols and safety standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing patients for imaging, positioning equipment, ensuring accurate image capture, and maintaining detailed records of procedures. The role also involves monitoring radiation exposure, collaborating with physicians and other healthcare professionals, and maintaining imaging equipment in good working condition. The Radiographer is expected to support high-quality patient care and adhere to all regulatory and institutional guidelines.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of Radiology and Radiologic Technology to perform and interpret imaging procedures accurately.
* Candidates should possess skills in Radiation and Radiation Safety to manage equipment and protect patients and staff from unnecessary exposure.
* Candidates should possess a foundational understanding of Medicine to work effectively within a multidisciplinary clinical environment.
* Diploma or degree in Radiography/Radiologic Technology from a recognized institution.
* Valid registration or license as required by local regulatory authorities.
* Attention to detail, ability to follow protocols, and strong organizational skills.
* Effective communication skills and a respectful, patient-focused approach.
* Willingness to work in rotating shifts, including weekends and holidays, if required.
